decisions.question: Which concrete U.S. church-linked sources have a verified written route across the target periods, and what is the next justified step?
decisions.count_definition: A written source qualifies here only when bounded project observations include at least one currently readable church-linked written sermon, homily or transcript associated with a recorded date on or before 2022-11-30 and one dated in 2025, a named author, and an explicit institutional or author-affiliation link. This is a source-feasibility threshold, not independent delivery, historical online availability, copyright, corpus, full-year or causal validation.

items.name: Fourth Presbyterian Church
items.institution_link: Official church-hosted archive and manuscript bylines; dated bulletins document advertised services, not exact delivery.
items.annual_scope: Visible official year indexes enumerated: 55 records in 2022 and 52 in 2025, with 50/41 manuscript links. Selected 33 target checks produced 28 without an observed selected-field conflict. This is not a validated 107-text corpus.
items.next_step: Use the four named-author groups with explicit occasion and source evidence. A complete diagnostic of the 28 no-inspected-conflict targets gives 53 same-speaker cross-year edges but only 3 same-calendar-month edges using 2 distinct later texts. Month matching is optional and does not by itself establish comparability. Do not silently reassign quarantined source mismatches.
items.rights: No explicit open sermon license established. Exact acquisition, analysis and redistribution scope needs review.

items.name: St. Mark's Episcopal Church / Adam Thomas author archive
items.institution_link: Official St Mark’s pages link the author archive and identify Adam Thomas as rector. This supports an author–church association, not independent proof that every listed sermon was delivered at that parish.
items.annual_scope: The fixed author index has 43 records dated 2022 and 45 dated 2025. Its 1,935 cross-year combinations include 1,800 under the inclusive November 30, 2022 cutoff, with 14 exact-label/whole-reference candidates. All ten complete-reference-list candidates now have detail observations at 20 distinct pages; nine raw detail labels match and one pair has equivalent occasion with different wording. Four partial-reference candidates remain index-only. The 2022 index has 41 Sunday-labeled rows but 40 calendar Sunday dates; 2025 has 42. These are not acquired or historically frozen texts.
items.next_step: Compare the ten documented pairs with their raw headers, short researcher comparisons, page-specific license observations and version limits. Resolve the four partial-reference candidates separately; do not infer AI exposure or text reuse from a passage match.
items.rights: Observed BY-NC-ND 3.0 notice plus separately copyrighted quoted material. Do not substitute 4.0 terms, assume noncommercial research automatically qualifies, or infer blanket adaptation permission.

items.name: Memorial Congregational Church / Allen Vander Meulen author archive
items.institution_link: The three inspected manuscripts name the church as their venue. The official current profile identifies an affiliated streaming worship producer and occasional preacher, not evidence of weekly pastoral incumbency or each historical event.
items.annual_scope: Three bounded manuscript observations: one 2022 and two 2025. Annual inventory and regular weekly continuity not established.
items.next_step: Retain as a clearly attributed occasional-preacher supplement, not the main continuous panel. Verify each work's license and version before proposed reuse.
items.rights: Individual inspected works show BY-NC 4.0 terms; this does not license unrelated works, third-party quotations, all project purposes or prove historical delivery.

items.name: St. Thomas More Catholic Church
items.institution_link: Parish archive and clergy listing support historical deacon affiliation. He died February 17, 2025; he is not a current pastor.

before_example.date_basis: Archive label and filename; no date in the inspected body
before_example.speaker: Tony Patronite

items.annual_scope: Visible target-year sections contain 7/2 links. Four selected PDF bodies read, including a 2022 December item after the cutoff. Not a regular full-year source.
items.next_step: Use only as a historical same-person/same-feast supplement; retain date and quoted-liturgical-text caveats.
items.rights: All Rights Reserved notice; no open reuse grant established.

items.name: Ave Maria Catholic Church
items.institution_link: Historical pastor evidence covers target years. Current 2026 transfer does not change historical authorship. Different institution from Ave Maria Parker, Colorado.
items.annual_scope: 38/2 visible target-year PDF links; four selected bodies read. Full-year boundary unresolved. A university baccalaureate and different rites cannot be pooled as ordinary Sunday sermons.
items.next_step: Retain for selected genre-matched qualitative comparisons; resolve archive boundary before any continuity claim.
items.rights: No explicit open sermon reuse grant established.

items.name: St. James Cathedral
items.route: Cathedral-hosted written manuscripts plus separate event media index
items.institution_link: Official cathedral and diocesan identity. Ryan changed from pastor to emeritus on July 1, 2025 and continued occasional preaching; Gary succeeded him.

before_example.date_basis: Conflicted heading: URL and related Sunday event suggest May 1. Do not silently normalize.
before_example.speaker: Michael G. Ryan

items.annual_scope: 130 event-index URLs cover labels for all 52 Sundays in each target year, not verified recordings. 2025 written indexes: 48 writing URLs, 46 homily candidates, 45 after known wrong-content quarantine across 38 Sundays. 2022 annual written coverage unknown.
items.next_step: Priority Western Catholic source, not a ready pre/post text panel. A further bounded official navigation/search check still did not locate a 2022 written-year inventory; annual coverage remains unknown. Preserve author transition, mixed voices, wrong-content link and service-specific partial-video warning.
items.rights: No explicit open sermon reuse grant established; no media or transcript acquired.

items.name: Christ Covenant Church
items.institution_link: Official church pages identify PCA affiliation and Matthews location. The current official biography names Kevin DeYoung as Senior Pastor and states that he accepted the call in 2017; inspected 2022 and 2025 sermon pages name the same senior pastor.

before_example.date_basis: Explicit sermon date on current official sermon page, not proof that this written version was online then
before_example.speaker: Kevin DeYoung

items.annual_scope: All 14 items in two named seven-item series have substantial written-body evidence: 11 newer observations and three retained earlier observations. The 2022 series contains six DeYoung items and one Wells item; only three DeYoung entries are dated on or before November 30, 2022. The 2025 series has seven DeYoung items. Annual coverage and historical text versions remain unknown.
items.next_step: Use the bounded series evidence to design exact speaker/date/occasion comparisons. Resolve the April 28 Monday versus Sunday Morning conflict and establish a genuine annual inventory and intended-use rights before expanding claims.
items.rights: No open sermon reuse grant established. Printable Transcript controls are offered but were not tested and do not establish a general license; assess exact copying, analysis and sharing operations separately.

separate_recording_route.name: Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Church
separate_recording_route.count_scope: 97 visible audio-link records: 47 in 2022 and 50 in 2025, covering 39 of 52 calendar Sundays in 2022 and 47 of 52 in 2025. No audio was played, downloaded or transcribed.
separate_recording_route.next_step: Define same-person, month and adult/youth service subsets; establish permitted audio access/transcription before text comparison.
separate_recording_route.rights: No blanket ASR or redistribution permission established.

limits: Seven is a scoped positive source-evidence count, not a count of licensed, complete, representative or fully independent church panels.
The sources are purposefully discovered and geographically/traditionally unbalanced, not a national sample.
Author dates, publication dates, current affiliations, advertised events and actual delivered words remain separate evidence levels.
Do not add these counts to 86 supported identities, 150 historical entities, 12 earlier source screens or 47 item records.
No difference between 2022 and 2025 alone establishes AI adoption or causal AI effects.
A recorded date in the target period does not establish that the current surviving text version existed at that historical date.
The geographic spread covers all four broad U.S. regions but is purposefully selected, not representative.
Original baseline and earlier source-screen snapshots retain their own historical counts; this decision ledger has a separately defined source count.

summary.strict_rule: Exact normalized feast/liturgical label plus at least one exactly equal whole normalized scripture reference. Complete-list equality reported separately.
limits: Index metadata only. Not body verification or evidence of reuse.
The 2022 cutoff uses index date, not inferred delivery or URL publication date.
A title version marker is only a version cue, not proof that a 2022 candidate is the prior version.
No AI-exposure or historical-wording assumption.
Previously recorded BY-NC-ND 3.0 is not new authorization; third-party rights remain separate.
summary.scope: Fixed annual index map, with a separate latest detail layer for all ten cutoff-eligible complete-reference-list candidates.
